businessRules: Availability uses half-open intervals and exact units.

Expose inventoryBlocks as an authenticated Booking GraphQL query for exactly one canonical property ID.
Authorize inventory:read against the current Property-owned branch membership before reading Booking data; dependency failure, unmapped property, and foreign partition fail closed.
Optional date filters use half-open overlap semantics; type/status filters are exact enums and empty arrays mean all values.
